::: {.landing-hero}
# TraceGym

::: {.tag}
Record → replay → score → gate.
:::

::: {.sub}
Agent demos are easy. Agent regressions are silent. TraceGym records an agent
once, replays it deterministically with no API keys, scores it with layered
deterministic checks and a calibrated LLM-judge ensemble, and blocks regressions
in CI before they merge.
:::

::: {.hero-badges}
$0 · zero API keys · OpenTelemetry-native
:::

[Try the demo](#try-it){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
[See it catch real bugs](case-studies.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg}
[View the live report](report.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg}
:::

## The pipeline

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Agent] --> C[Capture<br/>OTel GenAI spans]
  C --> S[(Store<br/>SQLite + blobs)]
  S --> R[Replay<br/>frozen, keyless]
  R --> L1[L1 checks]
  R --> L2[L2 judges]
  L1 --> G{Gate}
  L2 --> G
  G -->|regression| B[Block]
  G -->|clean| P[Pass]
  S --> D[Advisor]
```

## What it evaluates

[task completion]{.pill} [tool selection]{.pill} [tool-call efficiency]{.pill}
[context fidelity]{.pill} [trajectory validity]{.pill} [SQL execution accuracy]{.pill}
[cost budgets]{.pill} [latency budgets]{.pill} [PII safety]{.pill}

An agent is benchmarked against a reference: a prior version, an alternate model,
or a deterministic domain solver. See [How it works](how-it-works.qmd) and the
[calibration](calibration.qmd) protocol.

## Try it {#try-it}

One command, no keys, nothing leaves your machine:

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/hoomanesteki/tracegym-ai-agent-evaluation tracegym demo
```

It builds a self-contained workspace, replays the suites offline, blocks the
seeded regressions, and opens the [report](report.html).
